question: Who's picking up the visitors from the airport?
options: Grace is going to meet them at gate three.
The visitors arrived a bit early.
Yes, the flight landed on time.
explanation_zh: 問題問「誰」去接機，只有 (A) 明確指出是 Grace。(B) 講訪客提早到了，是話題轉移，沒有回答是誰去接。(C) 用 yes 回答 Wh- 問題，答非所問，所以答案是 (A)。

question: What time does the pharmacy close tonight?
options: It closes at ten tonight.
I bought some cold medicine there.
No, it opens at nine in the morning.
explanation_zh: 問題問藥局「幾點」關門，只有 (A) 給出明確時間。(B) 講在那裡買了感冒藥，是話題轉移，沒有回答關門時間。(C) 用 no 回答 Wh- 問題，且內容講的是開門時間而非關門時間，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Where did you park the delivery truck?
options: Right behind the loading dock.
The park down the street is closed.
It arrived a little late today.
explanation_zh: 問題問卡車停在「哪裡」，只有 (A) 給出具體位置。(B) 的 park 雖然重複出現，但意思變成「公園」，是詞義混淆陷阱。(C) 講貨車今天晚到，答非所問，是話題轉移，所以答案是 (A)。

question: When does the new software update roll out?
options: Next Monday, according to IT.
The software crashed twice today.
I rolled up the carpet already.
explanation_zh: 問題問軟體更新「何時」推出，只有 (A) 給出明確時間。(B) 講軟體當機了兩次，屬於話題轉移，沒有回答時間。(C) 的 rolled up 與 roll out 發音相近，是音似陷阱，內容卻與更新時間無關，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Why did the vendor cancel the order?
options: They ran out of raw materials.
The order arrived a day late.
I ordered lunch for the whole team.
explanation_zh: 問題問廠商「為什麼」取消訂單，只有 (A) 用具體原因回答。(B) 講訂單晚了一天送達，答非所問，是話題轉移。(C) 的 ordered 雖與問題重複，但講的是訂午餐，是詞彙重複陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: How do you access the shared drive from home?
options: You need to log in through the VPN first.
I have a spare key to the front door.
The drive to the office takes about an hour.
explanation_zh: 問題問「如何」從家裡連上共用硬碟，只有 (A) 給出具體步驟。(B) 由 access 聯想到 key（鑰匙），是詞彙聯想陷阱，與硬碟存取無關。(C) 的 drive 雖然重複，但意思變成「開車」，是詞義混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: What's the deadline for submitting expense reports?
options: This Friday by five o'clock.
I already expensed my hotel stay.
No, the reports were all approved.
explanation_zh: 問題問報帳「截止日期」，只有 (A) 給出明確時間。(B) 的 expensed 與 expense 字根相同但答非所問，是同源詞混淆陷阱。(C) 用 no 回答 Wh- 問題，屬於答錯類型，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Who approved the budget increase for marketing?
options: The finance director signed off on it.
The marketing campaign launched last week.
Yes, it was a significant increase.
explanation_zh: 問題問「誰」核准了預算增加，只有 (A) 明確指出是財務總監。(B) 講行銷活動上週上線，屬於話題轉移，沒有回答是誰核准的。(C) 用 yes 回答 Wh- 問題，答非所問，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Did you renew your parking permit yet?
options: Yes, I renewed it online this morning.
The parking lot is under construction.
I permitted him to leave early.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 yes 回答並補充細節。(B) 講停車場正在施工，是話題轉移，沒有回答是否更新。(C) 的 permitted 與 permit 字根相同但意思是「允許」，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Is the Wi-Fi password still the same?
options: No, it was changed last week.
I forgot my email password again.
Yes, the connection is really fast today.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 no 回答並說明現況。(B) 的 password 雖然重複，但講的是信箱密碼，是話題轉移。(C) 開頭說 yes 卻接著講網速很快，答非所問，是假肯定陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Have you submitted your timesheet for this week?
options: Not yet, I'll do it this afternoon.
The time difference is really confusing.
Yes, I worked a lot of overtime yesterday.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確回答還沒交並說明何時會交。(B) 的 time 雖然重複，但講的是時差，是詞彙聯想陷阱。(C) 開頭說 yes 卻講加班的事，答非所問，屬於假肯定陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Will the caterer arrive before the guests?
options: Yes, they're setting up right now.
The guests are running a little late.
I've ordered catering for events before.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 yes 回答並說明現況。(B) 講賓客會晚一點到，答非所問，是話題轉移。(C) 的 catering 雖然重複，但講的是過去經驗，並未回答本次順序問題，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Did the courier pick up the package already?
options: Yes, about twenty minutes ago.
The package was slightly damaged.
It weighs about five kilograms.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 yes 回答並補充時間。(B) 講包裹有點損壞，屬於話題轉移，沒有回答是否已取件。(C) 講包裹重量，同樣答非所問，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Is the projector working in the main conference room?
options: No, we need to replace the bulb.
The conference starts at nine sharp.
I'm projecting a ten percent increase.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 no 回答並說明原因。(B) 的 conference 雖然重複，但答非所問，是話題轉移。(C) 的 projecting 與 projector 字根相同但意思是「預估」，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Have you heard back from the supplier about the delay?
options: Not yet, I'll call them again today.
The supplier just raised their prices.
Yes, the delay was fairly short.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確回答還沒收到回覆並說明下一步。(B) 講供應商漲價，屬於話題轉移，沒有回答是否收到回覆。(C) 雖然說 yes，但只評論延誤時間長短，並未確認是否已收到回覆，是模糊的假肯定陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Does this elevator go up to the rooftop terrace?
options: No, you'll need to take the stairs from the tenth floor.
The terrace has a really great view.
I elevated my chair last week.
explanation_zh: 這是 yes/no 問題，只有 (A) 明確以 no 回答並提供替代方式。(B) 稱讚露台的視野很棒，是話題轉移，沒有回答電梯是否到得了。(C) 的 elevated 與 elevator 字根相同但意思是「調高」，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: You've already set up the projector for the keynote, haven't you?
options: Yes, it's all ready to go.
The keynote speaker arrives at noon.
I set the table for dinner last night.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認投影機是否已架設好，只有 (A) 明確肯定並說明狀態。(B) 講主講人中午到，屬於話題轉移，沒有確認投影機的事。(C) 的 set 雖然重複，但講的是擺餐桌，是詞彙重複但語意不同的陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: You already registered for the conference, didn't you?
options: Yes, I registered last week.
The conference is being held downtown.
I registered a complaint with HR.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認對方是否已報名研討會，只有 (A) 明確肯定並補充時間。(B) 講研討會辦在市區，屬於話題轉移，沒有確認是否報名。(C) 的 registered 雖然重複，但講的是「提出申訴」，是詞義混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: This is the last box for the move, isn't it?
options: Yes, that's everything.
The movers arrive at nine tomorrow.
I moved to a new apartment last year.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認這是搬家的最後一箱，只有 (A) 明確肯定。(B) 的 movers 與 move 字根相同但答非所問，是同源詞混淆陷阱。(C) 講去年搬到新公寓，時態不符且屬於話題轉移，所以答案是 (A)。

question: You haven't tried the new cafeteria menu yet, have you?
options: Actually, I had lunch there yesterday.
The menu changes every month.
Yes, I'm currently on a diet.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認對方是否試過新菜單，只有 (A) 明確說明已經去吃過。(B) 講菜單每個月更換，屬於話題轉移，沒有正面回答。(C) 開頭說 yes 卻講在節食，答非所問，是假肯定陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: We're supposed to wear name tags at the event, aren't we?
options: Yes, they're available at the registration desk.
The event was rescheduled to Friday.
I tagged along with my coworker.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認活動是否要戴名牌，只有 (A) 明確肯定並說明領取地點。(B) 講活動改期到週五，屬於話題轉移，沒有確認名牌的事。(C) 的 tagged 與 tag 字根相同但意思是「跟著去」，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: The new hire starts next Monday, doesn't she?
options: That's right, in the marketing department.
She hired a moving company last month.
Monday's meeting got canceled.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認新員工下週一到職，只有 (A) 明確肯定並補充部門。(B) 的 hired 與 hire 字根相同但意思是「僱用（搬家公司）」，是同源詞混淆陷阱。(C) 講週一的會議取消了，屬於話題轉移，所以答案是 (A)。

question: You backed up the server before the migration, didn't you?
options: Of course, I did it last night.
The migration took about three hours.
I backed the car out of the garage.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認是否已備份伺服器，只有 (A) 明確肯定並說明時間。(B) 講遷移花了三小時，屬於話題轉移，沒有確認是否備份。(C) 的 backed 雖然重複，但講的是「倒車」，是詞義混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: This isn't the final version of the contract, is it?
options: No, legal is still reviewing it.
The contract expires in June.
I finally finished the report.
explanation_zh: 附加問句在確認合約是否為最終版本，只有 (A) 明確否定並說明現況。(B) 講合約到期日，屬於話題轉移，沒有回答版本問題。(C) 的 finally 與 final 字根相近但意思不同，是音似／詞形混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Could you please forward me the minutes from yesterday's meeting?
options: Sure, I'll send them right after this call.
I only have a few minutes to spare.
The next meeting starts at three.
explanation_zh: 這是一個請求，最佳回應是答應並說明何時處理，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 的 minutes 雖然重複，但意思變成「幾分鐘」，是詞義混淆陷阱。(C) 講下一場會議的時間，屬於話題轉移，所以答案是 (A)。

question: The vending machine on this floor ate my money again.
options: I'll report it to building maintenance.
I vent my frustrations by jogging.
The machine was installed last year.
explanation_zh: 這是一句抱怨自動販賣機故障的陳述，最佳回應應主動提供協助，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 的 vent 與 vending 發音相近，是音似陷阱，內容卻與販賣機無關。(C) 講機器是去年安裝的，屬於話題轉移，沒有回應目前的故障，所以答案是 (A)。

question: You should really back up your photos before you sell your old phone.
options: Good point, I'll do that tonight.
I sold my phone for a good price.
The photo album is in the top drawer.
explanation_zh: 這是一句建議，最佳回應應是對建議的反應，只有 (A) 表示同意並會照做。(B) 講手機賣了好價錢，時態不符且屬於話題轉移。(C) 的 photo 雖然重複，但講的是相簿放在抽屜，答非所問，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Would you mind turning off the lights when you leave the lab?
options: Not at all, I'll switch them off.
The lab results came back normal.
I left my badge at the front desk.
explanation_zh: 這是一個請求，最佳回應是答應並採取行動，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 的 lab 雖然重複，但講的是檢驗結果，屬於話題轉移。(C) 的 left 與 leave 字根相同但意思不同，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: It looks like we're running low on printer paper.
options: I'll order some more from the supply closet.
The printer jammed again this morning.
I printed the report double-sided.
explanation_zh: 這是一句提出問題的陳述，最佳回應應提出解決辦法，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 講印表機又卡紙了，屬於話題轉移，沒有回應紙張不足的問題。(C) 的 printed 與 printer 字根相同但答非所問，是同源詞混淆陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Your presentation on the quarterly earnings was excellent.
options: Thank you, I practiced a lot beforehand.
The earnings report comes out on Monday.
Yes, I earned a nice bonus this year.
explanation_zh: 這是一句稱讚的陳述，最佳回應是道謝並回應，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 講財報將於週一發布，時態不符，屬於話題轉移。(C) 的 earned 與 earnings 字根相同但答非所問，且用 yes 回答陳述句，屬於類型錯誤陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Why don't you join us for the team lunch on Friday?
options: I'd love to, thanks for asking.
Friday is usually our busiest day.
I already had lunch a while ago.
explanation_zh: 這是一個邀約，最佳回應是接受或回應邀約，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 講週五通常最忙，並未明確接受或婉拒邀約，是模糊的話題轉移。(C) 講稍早已經吃過午餐，時態與情境不符，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Don't forget to badge in before you enter the server room.
options: Thanks for reminding me, I almost forgot.
The server has been down since noon.
I have a spare badge in my bag.
explanation_zh: 這是一個提醒事項，最佳回應是表示會照做，只有 (A) 符合。(B) 講伺服器中午就當機了，屬於話題轉移，沒有回應刷卡的提醒。(C) 提到包包裡有備用識別證，看似相關卻答非所問，屬於誤導性陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Should we send the client's order by air or by sea?
options: Air would be faster for this order.
The order was quite heavy this time.
Yes, we should send it out soon.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確在兩個選項中選了空運。(B) 講這批貨很重，屬於話題轉移，沒有做出選擇。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Do you want your coffee with milk or black?
options: Black, please, no milk.
The coffee machine is broken again.
No, I don't really drink coffee.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了黑咖啡。(B) 講咖啡機又壞了，屬於話題轉移，沒有做出選擇。(C) 用 no 回答選擇問句，屬於答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Would you rather meet in person or join by video call?
options: Video call works better for me.
The video was a bit too long.
Yes, let's meet up soon.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了視訊會議。(B) 的 video 雖然重複，但講的是影片太長，屬於話題轉移。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Is the training session in the morning or the afternoon?
options: It's scheduled for the afternoon.
The morning traffic was terrible today.
No, it's actually been canceled.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了下午。(B) 講今天早上塞車，屬於話題轉移，沒有做出選擇。(C) 用 no 回答選擇問句，屬於答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Should I file this under 'clients' or 'vendors'?
options: Put it under 'vendors', I think.
The file cabinet is locked right now.
Yes, that folder is completely full.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了 vendors 這個分類。(B) 的 file 雖然重複，但講的是檔案櫃上鎖了，屬於話題轉移。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Do you prefer the window seat or the aisle seat?
options: I'll take the aisle seat, thanks.
The window needs a good cleaning.
Yes, the flight is completely full.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了走道座位。(B) 的 window 雖然重複，但講的是窗戶需要清潔，屬於話題轉移。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Are we paying by credit card or by invoice?
options: Let's go with the invoice this time.
The credit card was declined earlier.
Yes, the payment went through fine.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了用發票（月結）付款。(B) 講信用卡剛剛被拒絕，屬於話題轉移，沒有做出選擇。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。

question: Should the banner go on the front wall or the side wall?
options: The front wall would get more attention.
The wall was just repainted last week.
Yes, it looks great where it is.
explanation_zh: 這是選擇問句，只有 (A) 明確選了正面牆。(B) 講牆壁上週剛粉刷，屬於話題轉移，沒有做出選擇。(C) 用 yes 回答選擇問句，是答非所問的類型陷阱，所以答案是 (A)。
